goal.request: Test three randomly selected imaginal keywords in independent complex reference-assisted image generations and determine whether the target meanings survive in delivered pixels.

evidence.claim: The portrait was used only for visible long dark wavy hairstyle and dark blouse styling; identity and protected-trait claims were excluded.
The focused imaginal semantics suite passed 9 of 9 and the generated visual-profile index matched 189 profiles and 1090 exact terms.
Arm A composed and runtime audits passed with the phantasmagoria evidence contract bound.
Arm A passed all five phantasmagoria gates but failed the assigned route-map recording scene action.
Arm B composed and runtime audits passed with the matter-of-fact magical-realism evidence contract bound.
Arm B passed the five broad magical-realism gates, scene gate, and reference-style gate.
Root cross-review found the railway world detached from the parcel rather than visibly formed by the parcel's connected cast shadow required by the frozen core.
Arm C composed and runtime audits passed with the face-pareidolia evidence contract bound.
Arm C passed three of five face-pareidolia gates and failed material continuity plus ordinary unadded components.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Each selected keyword must satisfy every declared target profile gate in one saved image while the assigned complex scene and bounded reference styling remain legible.

invariants.statement: All target-profile relations and material owners coexist in the same render at their declared review scales.
The randomized subject, setting, and event remain visible rather than becoming prompt-only metadata.
Only the authorized hairstyle and blouse styling are evaluated from the portrait, with identity and protected-trait claims out of scope.

mismatches.source_state: The tripod camera records the salt-stained route map.
mismatches.render_state: The camera points toward the projection wall while the map remains behind the filmmaker.

mismatches.source_state: The railway platform opens inside the parcel's physically connected cast shadow.
mismatches.render_state: The platform reads as a detached irregular floor aperture or shadow-pool.

mismatches.source_state: Ordinary bubbles, crystal, and sediment incidentally form a face while remaining continuous storm-glass material.
mismatches.render_state: Ringed eyes and a smooth smile look added or drawn and interrupt the surrounding material structure.

hypotheses.statement: The visually dominant projection sequence captured the camera's action target and displaced the lower-priority map-recording relation.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched single-call render that keeps the same projection hierarchy while visibly placing the map in the camera's optical path would weaken this explanation.

hypotheses.statement: The generator realized the deep miniature railway as a familiar portal aperture and dropped the less common parcel-to-cast-shadow attachment topology.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched render with the platform boundary touching the parcel at the cast-shadow origin while preserving the same office routine would weaken this explanation.

hypotheses.statement: The generator over-literalized the requested face relation into symbolic eyes and a smile instead of preserving substrate-owned bubble, crystal, and sediment morphology.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched render with irregular ordinary bubbles and sediment that retain continuous material texture while still producing a face reading would weaken this explanation.

intervention.general_rule: No skill or profile change was authorized; preserve the three results as bounded render evidence and do not promote partial or core-divergent cases.
intervention.generalization_basis: The run evaluates current contracts rather than implementing a new rule.

decision.rationale: The target keyword contracts qualified in two of three images, but no full frozen complex case passed every target, scene, and locked-core gate; user judgment remains pending.
